taskPrompt: For an Account update, list every automation that runs, the order it runs in, and every record each one writes or references.
startingPoint: Account object in Setup with source metadata only, before any deployment or execution.

expansionProfile.notes: No subflow chains; single-level references only.

inclusionRationale: Pilot that mixes programmatic and declarative automation and holds one dynamic SOQL a human knows targets Contact, so it exercises confirmed dependency edges, an inferred flow edge, and a deliberately unresolvable reference the tool must miss rather than guess.
notes: Account update pilot: Apex trigger split before/after with a dependency-record class reference and one dynamic SOQL that a human knows targets Contact; before-save and after-save flows, after-save creating a Task; one validation rule.
